description: Instrument services with structured logs, metrics and traces. Correlation ids, log levels, dashboards and alerts that point at the cause.

# Observability and logging

## Structured logs
Emit JSON with a timestamp, level, message and a correlation id carried across services.

## Metrics
Track rate, errors and duration for every endpoint. Alert on symptoms users feel, such as
error rate and latency, rather than on CPU.

## Traces
Propagate trace context through queues and HTTP calls so one request can be followed end to
end.
